name: claude-write-gains-final-newline
description: The base file has no final newline. A Claude Write replaces its last line and the new content ends with a newline. Only a Write reveals this to WHY (its `after` fingerprint carries the final-newline flag), so this is a replay scenario; an Edit that gained a newline would not be. The patch shows `alpha` as context (rule 2: base) and the replaced last line as e1.
